polity.definition: Political entity; government belongs here, not to each owned location.

government-class.definition: Controlled primary government vocabulary identity; not an assignment.

language.definition: Spoken-language identity; does not imply culture, script or dialect.

disease.definition: Disease identity independent of its dated outbreaks.

outbreak.definition: One outbreak identity; multiple outbreaks may affect a location concurrently.

river.definition: Cataloged river or reach; contact does not establish navigability.

lake.definition: Cataloged inland lake, including saline lakes.

marine-shoreline.definition: Marine shoreline reference feature; distinct from inland lakes.

port.definition: Port facility identity, independent of settlement rank and coastal contact.

port-function.definition: Reviewed functional service vocabulary; no inferred maritime capability.

atlas.total-gdp.definition: Total annual output for the supported territory.

atlas.median-purchasing-power.definition: Person-weighted median equivalized real disposable household income; not a mean or GDP.

atlas.adult-literacy.definition: Residents aged 15+ who read and write with understanding a short everyday statement.

atlas.annual-disease-deaths.definition: Disease-attributed deaths during the supported selected year; not cumulative cases or excess mortality.

atlas.government-primary.definition: One exclusive primary government class; ambiguity stays unresolved.

atlas.primary-spoken-language.definition: Supported primary everyday/home spoken language; broad evidence is not silently refined.

atlas.gdp-per-person.definition: Supported gdp-per-person observation; derivation is a separate domain responsibility.

atlas.total-gdp.definition: Supported total-gdp observation; derivation is a separate domain responsibility.

atlas.median-purchasing-power.definition: Supported median-purchasing-power observation; derivation is a separate domain responsibility.

atlas.adult-literacy.definition: Supported adult-literacy observation; derivation is a separate domain responsibility.

atlas.annual-disease-deaths.definition: Supported annual-disease-deaths observation; derivation is a separate domain responsibility.

atlas.river-lake-contact.definition: Contact with a complete applicable major-river/lake catalog; missing coverage is unknown.

atlas.marine-contact.definition: Supported direct marine-shoreline contact; inland lakes and nearby pixels do not establish it.

atlas.port-functions.definition: Explicitly documented active facility functions; river-sited maritime is not automatically mixed.

atlas.outbreak-disease.definition: Dated sourced disease attribution for an outbreak.

atlas.outbreak-location.definition: Dated affected location; no automatic aggregation or annual allocation.

atlas.water-location.definition: Sourced dated feature contact; geometry approval remains separate.

atlas.port-location.definition: Dated location association; does not alone establish operating status or functions.
